BPR-max uses negative-only weights s_j=exp(r_j)/Σ_k exp(r_k) and loss −log[Σ_j s_j sigmoid(r_i−r_j)+ε]+λΣ_j s_j r_j². The logarithm encloses the weighted probability sum; this is not a weighted sum of log-losses. Gradients flow through the softmax weights in both terms: detaching them changes the objective. Negative-score regularization penalizes squared scores, weighted toward high-scoring negatives; it is distinct from parameter weight decay. See [paper, equations 12–16](https://arxiv.org/html/1706.03847) and [official loss implementation](https://github.com/hidasib/GRU4Rec_PyTorch_Official/blob/master/gru4rec_pytorch.py#L423-L434).

Official sampling draws additional items with replacement, proportional to training frequency^sample_alpha, and combines these with minibatch targets. Duplicate item IDs remain separate candidate columns, increasing their aggregate softmax mass. Only each row’s designated positive diagonal is masked; an identical positive item appearing elsewhere, including an accidental sampled hit, remains in the negative pool. There is no blanket history exclusion or item-ID collision rejection. Thus n_sample=16 means 16 additional draws plus minibatch negatives, not 16 total negatives. See [official sampler and iterator](https://github.com/hidasib/GRU4Rec_PyTorch_Official/blob/master/gru4rec_pytorch.py#L238-L346).

Recommended controls: cross objective (mean pairwise BPR versus BPR-max) with negative count (1 versus 16), separately ablate λ, and hold sampling distribution, replacement, collision/history policy, score activation, initialization, GRU architecture, optimizer, loss reduction, batches and validation selection fixed. With one valid negative and λ=0, BPR-max equals ordinary BPR. Explicitly distinguish total negatives from additional samples; report duplicate/hit rates and effective counts. Apply identical rejection rules across comparisons if departing from official behavior. Preserve seed 42 and fixed evaluation; report runtime because equal update counts have different costs. Comparing only one-negative BPR against regularized 16-negative BPR-max confounds three changes.
